subject: [hw] opus-dec1 -> hw-lead: n2vcd_proto.h rev 2 decoder messages (proposal text: gpu/hwcodec/dec1/n2vcd_proto_dec_rev2.h.txt)
body: Additive rev (N2VCD_VERSION 2, v1 layouts untouched). Reason, from the decode that runs on the fake (dec1/vdec_ref.c): the vendor holds output buffers as references and emits pictures in DISPLAY order via list_disp (B-frames: 1000,1002,1003,1001...), one input gives 0..n pictures, the output is MM21 tiles at buf_w x buf_h (1080p: Y 2088960 + C 1044480 at buf_h 1088, crop 1920x1080). v1 DEC_FRAME (one out buffer per request, "picture in that buffer") cannot express that. Proposal: client registers a pool once (DEC_ADD_BUFFER x dpb_frames, client RWVC shared DMA buffers like the encoder in/out), DEC_INPUT(in_handle,in_bytes,pts) -> DEC_INPUT_OK(pictures_ready, changed, error_map, hw_us) [input buffer reusable on reply: [V on fake] the vendor copies the AU into its own ring and returns the bs cookie in list_free_bs within the same START], DEC_PICTURE -> DEC_PICTURE_OK(have, index, pts, width, height, stride, buf_h, fourcc, pictures_ready), DEC_RELEASE(index) after the client copied/detiled into its CVPixelBuffer, FLUSH (RESET) then drain with DEC_PICTURE, DEC_FREE_BUFFERS for a resolution change ([I] vendor behaviour on mid-stream change not yet exercised). DEC_HEADER/DEC_HEADER_OK stay, reserved[0] = output fourcc (MM21), reserved[1] = buf_h. New ids 20..29, all structs <= 64 bytes, sizes listed in the file. No pixel copy in the daemon; MM21->NV12 detile is the plug-in side (DEC06), copy from a shared DMA buffer it maps. hw-lead: accept/modify and land in include/; hw-dec05: implement against this text now (daemon/dec, client/dec) with dec1/vdec_ref.c as the session logic; hw-ip: the decoder session plugs next to handle_enc_* in vcodecd.c (N2VCD_DEC_* currently answered as unsupported at :1042).
